purpose: descriptive inventory of measured-field eligibility and frozen four-target recovery; no training, no model selection, no biological PASS thresholds, no p-values
prediction_scope: 11 frozen splits (internal_0..4 over 72 sections, source_0..5 over 53 sections with a known study link); 1000 stored prediction packages; stored predictions are re-read, never retrained
measured_scope: 72 qualified sections; targets and reads exactly as frozen in infra/field_discovery_20261018/cache; section identity, organ, platform, study link and known-patient flag from the frozen manifest
geometry_unit: empirical nearest-neighbour pitch of each section (source pixels); no micrometre conversion and no native-HD or super-resolution claim

neighbourhoods.outer: row-normalised frozen graph, edges in (1.1, 3.1] pitch (cache/{sid}_outer.npz)

threshold_semantics: a spot counts as high when its value is strictly greater than the field's q-quantile (v > quantile(v,q)); this keeps zero-inflated readouts (many spots with no detected target transcript, value exactly 0) from filling the set with ties; geo_patch*_area_frac and geo_patch*_at_threshold_frac are reported for every field so the realised set size and the tie mass stay traceable; sets from different fields therefore need not have equal size
shuffle_reference_nature: descriptive perturbation preserving the field value marginal and destroying its spatial arrangement; spatial support and density are NOT preserved; not a null model; no p-value is computed and no relation is filtered by it; cost parameter shuffle_permutations is not a scientific threshold

computability_rules.nature: mathematical only; decides whether a number exists, never whether recovery succeeded
computability_rules.constant_field: sd == 0 -> correlation, autocorrelation, patch, centroid, decay and detail metrics not estimable
computability_rules.degenerate_hull: fewer than 3 non-collinear points -> centroid_hull_radial not estimable
computability_rules.empty_band: no spot pairs in a distance band -> that band value and decay not estimable
computability_rules.few_spots: fewer than 10 tissue spots -> patch and hull metrics not estimable
computability_rules.no_target_genes: no defined target gene present in the panel -> support and readout metrics not estimable
computability_rules.constant_module_vector: fewer than 3 estimable module relations -> relation-profile metrics not estimable
computability_rules.zero_variance_source: measured sd == 0 -> sd_ratio and calibration slope not estimable
computability_rules.empty_threshold_set: strictly-above-threshold set is empty -> patch metrics for that quantile not estimable
computability_rules.sd_below_floor: 0 < sd <= sd_floor -> correlation, autocorrelation, patch, centroid and scale metrics not estimable; RMSE stays

diagnostic_markers.nature: reporting convenience only; NOT gates; do not filter rows, do not change any metric, do not enter any state; sensitivity to neighbouring cutoffs is reported for each marker

reporting_states.nature: readable labels derived only from the computability rules; never a biological pass/fail judgement

sd_floor_nature: computational, not biological: the frozen fields are stored in float32, so variation below this floor cannot be separated from representation noise; any field (measured or predicted) with sd <= floor gets correlation, autocorrelation, patch, centroid and scale metrics NOT_ESTIMABLE, never 0 and never 1; RMSE/MAE/bias stay reported as diagnostics
sd_floor_evidence: the frozen source-holdout train_mean packages are stored with sd 0 or about 3e-8 (both below the floor); real target readouts in the checked sections have sd of order 1e-2

tolerances.reason: frozen tables were written from float32 arithmetic; the recompute is float64 over the same stored arrays, so differences of order 1e-7 are expected; tolerance is fixed before inspection and not relaxed to pass

denied_path_nature: defense in depth on top of the allowlist: any open() whose path contains one of these substrings raises, and setup asserts that no allowlisted path matches them

evidence_roles.measurement_eligibility: molecular detection coverage, gene support and measured-field distribution/geometry; describes the measured field only
evidence_roles.input_echo_relation_not_spatial_incremen: relation between a field and the visible module fields that entered the frozen model input; correlation here is partly definitional or input echo and is never evidence of a spatial increment
evidence_roles.exploratory_reanalysis_of_developed_pred: frozen predictions re-read and re-scored against the frozen measured readout; not retraining, not independent marker validation and not independent-patient confirmation

model_budgets.gene_ridge: raw visible genes, no neighbourhood input
model_budgets.gene_ridge_smooth_half: raw visible genes plus post-hoc 0.5 neighbourhood smoothing of its own prediction; autocorrelation gain is constructional
model_budgets.fixed_point_hgb: module scores at the same spot, no neighbourhood input
model_budgets.fixed_local_hgb: module scores plus neighbourhood means; different information budget from the point model
model_budgets.train_mean: constant prior (training mean); stored with sd 0 or float noise, hence never a ranked correlation baseline

arm_separation: internal folds and source holdouts are separate records; a section that appears in both arms yields two rows and is never merged into one recovery statement; no cross-budget verdict column is emitted (cross_budget_verdict is always 'none' in this phase)

interpretation_boundary.user_clarification_20261019: computation states describe whether a statistic exists; they are not biological eligibility
interpretation_boundary.statement: mathematically computable does not mean there is enough biological reference; low detection coverage, single-gene dominance, few effective genes, sparse boundary support and unconfirmed physical resolution still limit interpretation; no unified percentage rule is used to delete sections, targets or rows, and no computable cell is upgraded to biologically evaluated eligibility; this phase only produces a descriptive listing and leaves biological usability to the main agent, who combines these continuous evidence items with project context
interpretation_boundary.biological_usability_decision: deferred to the main agent; not awarded by this phase
interpretation_boundary.not_testable_reading: NOT_TESTABLE / NOT_ESTIMABLE means the statistic is undefined or below numerical resolution; it is never evidence that the field is absent or that recovery failed

no_biological_pass_threshold: this phase defines no success/significance cutoff for any metric; sparse detection and low gene support are reported continuously and never make a field NOT_TESTABLE

aggregation.section_to_unit: equal section weight inside a unit; estimable values only; NOT_ESTIMABLE_UNIT recorded otherwise
aggregation.unit_to_macro: equal unit weight within (arm, target, view, model); n_units and n_estimable reported; quantiles p10/p25/median/p75/p90 across unit values
aggregation.source_balanced: source-arm sensitivity: equal unit weight inside a source, then equal weight over the six known sources
aggregation.missing_values: never silently dropped; reasons counted and reported

integrity_checks: expression_sha256 of every section h5ad equals the frozen manifest value
recomputed target readout equals frozen cache y (max absolute difference reported)
prediction package barcodes and y equal the frozen cache arrays exactly
section pitch recomputed from coordinates equals the frozen manifest value
visible vocabulary and target gene set are disjoint
frozen module definitions equal the followup full15 module definitions
guard receipt contains no human-TLS, annotations or incoming path
recomputed rmse / centered_rmse / pearson equal the frozen section_metrics table for the checked rows
not_claimed: independent marker validation (existing models trained on the complete target gene set)
confirmed independent patients (8 known within-study units only)
physical scale, micrometre distance or super-resolution
formal significance from the shuffle perturbation
not_run: training or retraining of any model
human TLS label reading and structural validation
complex null models, density- or support-preserving calibration, p-values
